name: Antipaladin Bearer of Despair
body:
The bearer of despair wields doubt and hopelessness as a weapon against their foes.

Requirements

Alignment and Code of Conduct: A bearer of despair must be neutral evil or chaotic evil, but is still required to adhere to their code of conduct. If they commit a good act, change alignments outside of neutral evil or chaotic evil or break their oath, they lose their class features except for proficiencies. This alters code of conduct.

Dearth of Hope (Su)

At 3rd level, a bearer of despair radiates an aura that saps hope from all enemies within 10 feet. Those enemies take a -4 penalty on saving throws against despair effects. Creatures normally immune to despair effects lose that immunity while within 10 feet of a bearer of despair with this ability.

This ability functions only while the bearer of despair remains conscious, not if they are unconscious or dead.

This ability replaces aura of cowardice.

Cruelties (Su)

Add the following cruelties to the cruelties available to the bearer of despair.

3rd level
Doubting: The target is doubting for 1 round per level of the antipaladin.
6th level
Despairing: The target is despairing for 1 round per level of the antipaladin.
9th level
Hopeless: The target is hopeless for 1 round per level of the antipaladin

This ability modifies cruelties but does not preclude taking another archetype that replaces or modifies cruelties.
